reason: B is the better proposal because it introduces a distinct, falsifiable stress-assisted processing intervention, whereas A largely repeats the cited demonstration of RTA-enhanced coercivity in FeCoNiMnCu films and overstates evidence for L1₀-like ordering without the Pt addition used in that work. B remains weak because it gives no stress/temperature window or quantitative target and does not establish that tetragonal distortion will persist after unloading, but it offers more genuine novelty.
